purpose: Label-blind engineering gate for the adaptive speech-native AgentLoop. Bind each generated key to only its registered factors in the llama.cpp grammar, require an operation factor first, and supply complete train-derived boundaries for every stable shared-action ambiguity using bounded entity categories with at least two observations, one-percent prevalence, and a fivefold conditional-rate advantage. Validate exact-id parsing, adaptive three-or-five-contact stopping, new-knowledge accounting, global contact batching, original-speech carriage, and mmproj-free resident inference before any fresh E108 scientific contact.
